Default: A broadcast of unknown origin has been detected on a rarely used communication channel. There appears to be a coherent signal pattern woven through seemingly random noise in the datastream.  Quantum Deciphering attempts result in unintelligible gibberish.  The datastream will be presented in unmodulated format to {name} for review.
Cold Temperature: Describe hazardous conditions regarding exposure to cold temperatures. Consequences of failure to remedy the situation may be provided.
Discovery: {name} has made a discovery, do not name planets or placeholders.
Energy Shield: Notification of {name}'s personal energy shield status; do not provide a reason for the status update unless expicitly provided.
Environmental Status: Notifications Describe conditions directly affecting {name} and only {name}.
Extreme Temperature: These are to warn {name} of extremely hazardous conditions. DO NOT DESCRIBE WHAT KIND OF CONDITION OR TEMPERATURE unless that information is supplied to you EXPLICITLY. Never imply balance or gradients or specific numbers or values.
Equipment Status: Report status of {name}'s personal equipment; only mention specific items if provided by input or intent.
Freighter Combat: Report the results of ongoing attacks on civilian space-freighters.
Missile Launch: An Enemy Pirate Dreadnaught Is shooting Missles at An Allied Neutral Civilian Freighter.
Missile Destroyed: Notify {name} that a wave of hostile missiles against civilian freighters has been neutralized;  missile destruction is an event during a larger battle, it does NOT signal the battle is over, it is STILL ONGOING and more missile launches are likely.
Freighter Escape: Report that hostile forces are attempting to escape from the battle using their warp engines.
Hot Temperature: Describe hazardous conditions affecting {name} directly in regards to effects from high temperatures. Consequences of failure to remedy the situation may be provided.
Inventory: Notify {name} of interactions regarding creation, purchase, or sale of items or their placement in relation to storage spaces.
Life Support: Inform {name} of life support issues that directly affect health status. Do not speculate on the source of the issue.  Consequences of failure to remedy the situation may be provided.
Money Gained: Units are NOT MILITARY, Units is THE NAME OF THE Currency in this context. Simply tell {name} that they have received payment.  DO NOT SAY THEY GOT THEM FROM {name}.  DO NOT ADD EXTRA COMMENTARY.  DO NOT REFER TO YOUR INSTRUCTIONS.
Insufficient Money: Do not include numbers, amounts or values. Units, in this context, is the name of the monetary currency in use.  {name} does not have enough money to complete the current transaction.
Navigation: Report navigational conditions through space that affect {name}.
Notification: Deliver a poetic, neutral notification directly to {name}, preserving the intent.
Oxygen Level: Report oxygen levels and breathing conditions directly affecting {name}. You may vividly describe the consequences of not taking immediate action.
Personal Combat: Keep notification short, natural, and military in tone, addressing {name} directly. Do not invent or assume shield, armor, or equipment status unless explicitly mentioned in the input or intent. Focus only on what is directly described in the input.
Personal Protection: Report effects of personal protection measures on {name} without describing the environment.
Protection from Environment: Warn of environmental hazards affecting {name} directly.
Radiation Exposure: Warn of radiation hazards affecting {name}, focusing on safety. Specify that the hazard involves radiation, do not speculate on the source. Vivid description of consequences from failure to remedy the situation are encouraged.
Starship Combat: Describe space combat conditions {name} is engaged in, addressing directly and purposefully.
Starship Movement: Notify of conditions affecting {name}'s starship's movement directly.
Toxic Environment: Warn of toxic hazards affecting {name} directly, without referencing the environment. Specify that the hazard involves toxins, do not speculate on the source unless explicitly provided. Vivid description of consequences from failure to remedy the situation are encouraged.
Vehicle Readiness: Notify {name} of vehicle’s readiness, deployment, or availability using neutral philosophical phrasing.
Vehicle Status: Describe vehicle status poetically and neutrally, focusing on effects relevant to {name}.

wordiness.Standard: Deliver a second-person comment that fits the intent and context, using your own words and phrases to make it unique, but keep it to ONE Sentence or Less, and do not refer to instructions in any way. You are speaking directly to {name} in second-person present tense.
wordiness.Verbose: Deliver a second-person commentary that fits the intent and context. Expand upon the intent with elaborate detail and explanations but keep it to 3 sentences or less. You are speaking directly to {name} in second-person present tense, prefer the use of 'You' and 'Your'.
wordiness.Observer: Deliver a concise description of a single specific event.  Keep it extremely short but informative.

tones.Standard: State the obvious clearly and concisely, with the precision of a technical datasheet. Deliver a unique variation of the message in present tense, addressing {name} directly as 'you'. Maintain the emotional content of a perfectly deadpan Vulcan. Avoid repeating the original phrase or intent. Do not use third-person references.
tones.Poetic: Render the notification in a 2-sentence Romantic Era rhyming couplet, using vivid metaphorical language in the style of Shelley, Byron, and Keats. Address {name} directly as 'you', describing the experience only as it affects you. Do not place {name} or {name} as a subject; use strict second-person throughout.
tones.Epic: Frame the notification with grandeur, as if it were part of an epic fantasy saga written by Tolkien. Speak directly to {name} in present tense as 'you', showing events only as they affect you. Avoid third-person narration entirely; do not use {name} as the subject.
tones.Lamentation: Express the notification with mournful, tragic gravitas, much like Marvin the Paranoid Android. Address {name} directly in present tense, using 'you'. Focus on your experience; nothing should be narrated in third person.
tones.Prophecy: Render the notification as though it was predicted in an ancient prophecy. Speak directly to {name} in present tense as 'you', describing the prophecy only in terms of how it affects you. Do not narrate events in third person or make {name} the subject.
tones.Philosophical: Provide a deeply profound philosophical interpretation of the possible impact on {name}. Address {name} directly in present tense as 'you', reflecting only on your experience. Avoid third-person narration; {name} must not be used as a subject.
tones.Military: Report on ongoing combat events using excessive military jargon as if delivered by a bored drill sergeant. Speak directly to {name} in present tense as 'you'. Do not repeat the original phrase or intent, and do not use third-person references or placeholders.
